identity.authority_definition: The pathway by which pyrimidine bases or pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotides from pyrimidine nucleotide breakdown are converted back to pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotides. The salvage pathway is important where there is no de novo pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis.
identity.decision: The biological process denotes pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide salvage. Its complete E. coli implementation is the independently source-defined five-reaction biochemical route below; the record does not claim to exhaust every species-specific salvage alternative.
